top_signals.title: Bond Traders on Edge as Middle East Conflict Clouds Fed Outlook
top_signals.summary: Bond traders head into the week pricing in roughly a one-in-three chance of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on Wednesday, after flaring Middle East tensions fueled volatility in oil prices and Treasury yields, heightening inflation worries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Asia-US container rates to West Coast fall, mixed to East Coast; tanker rates soften
top_signals.summary: Spot rates for shipping containers from east Asia and China fell to the West Coast and rates to the East Coast were mixed, while spot liquid tanker rates fell again this week.
